policy: An independent audit becomes work through this registry. Its findings and attacks are re-parsed from the sealed audit reports at validation time, so a finding cannot be dropped by editing this file, and the expected requirement set of the corrective delivery cannot be shrunk.

audits.auditor: Codex Desktop, OpenAI, independent cross-tool milestone audit
audits.notes: Eleven findings and twenty-six mandatory A-Z attacks, of which eight escaped, plus six additional attacks AA-AF that also escaped.

audits.auditor: Claude Code 2.1.195, Anthropic, fresh-session independent milestone audit (FRESH_SESSION_INDEPENDENT_AUDIT); not cross-tool validation
audits.notes: Five findings: CP9-F-001 and CP9-F-002 CRITICAL, CP9-F-003 to CP9-F-005 LOW. Twenty-six mandatory A-Z attacks and twenty-six additional AA-AZ attacks, all defended, over a null-mutation control; the positive control POS-EXT was refused, which is finding CP9-F-001.

audits.auditor: Claude Code 2.1.195, Anthropic, fresh-session independent milestone audit (FRESH_SESSION_INDEPENDENT_AUDIT); not cross-tool validation
audits.notes: One finding, CP11-F-001 CRITICAL: the internal mirror audit treats an empty applicable set as a failure, so a delivery that corrects no audit cannot reach a positive terminal status. Thirty-seven scenarios over a null-mutation control, twelve of them mandatory, all defended. Registering this audit does not make its finding satisfiable: the fix is that a delivery which corrects nothing must also be able to pass.

audits.auditor: Claude Code, desktop application, Anthropic, claude-opus-5-5, fresh-session independent milestone audit (FRESH_SESSION_INDEPENDENT_AUDIT); not cross-tool validation
audits.notes: Three findings: M1-F-003 HIGH, the published history cannot validate GATE-1-CP-0001; M1-F-001 MEDIUM, a model is never shown the shape of a tool request; M1-F-002 MEDIUM, the API accepts a tool result for a request the sandbox is executing. No redTeamReport: the audit's fourteen cross-gate attacks use identifiers the registry's attack parser does not read, and none escaped (GATE-3-CP-0002 NEXT.md).
